meta.title: Configurable Multi-Level Approval Workflow: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and access the Configurable Multi-Level Approval Workflow configuration.
Verify that the non-Tenant Admin user is refused or does not receive the workflow configuration option.
Sign in as a Tenant Admin in the same tenant and verify that the workflow configuration is available.
Compare the two role outcomes and record any tenant RBAC configuration that grants access to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and access the Configurable Multi-Level Approval Workflow configuration.; Verify that the non-Tenant Admin user is refused or does not receive the workflow configuration option.; Sign in as a Tenant Admin in the same tenant and verify that the workflow configuration is available.; Compare the two role outcomes and record any tenant RBAC configuration that grants access to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as a non-Tenant Admin user, verify access to the Configurable Multi-Level Approval Workflow is refused or absent, then sign in as a Tenant Admin in the same tenant and verify the workflow configuration is available

steps.note: No catalog step can switch between these user roles or observe this administrative workflow.
Assert that the session remains free of application errors after the tester completes or skips the unavailable role-based check.
